title: 30-Day Content Calendar
description: Combine client context and trend insights into a 30-row content calendar — date, channel, pillar, format, topic, hook draft, and CTA — ready for client approval.

inputs.label: Trend insights file path (leave empty if none)

nodes.title: Design pillars and channel rhythm
nodes.detail: If insights_path points to a file, read it and fold recent trend formats and hooks into the plan; otherwise proceed from client, niche, and audience alone. Define 4–5 content pillars (e.g. educate / relate / prove / entertain / sell) with mix ratios, and set the weekly posting rhythm per channel (IG Reels, feed, Stories, Threads, etc.).
nodes.acceptance: 4+ pillars with ratios and a per-channel weekly rhythm are defined.

subtasks.title: Fold in trend insights
subtasks.purpose: Reuse recent winning formats and hooks as calendar material

subtasks.title: Define pillars and ratios
subtasks.purpose: Pillars matched to the client's goals

subtasks.title: Set channel rhythm
subtasks.purpose: Days and frequency per channel as the calendar skeleton

nodes.title: Write the 30-day calendar CSV
nodes.detail: Write a CSV with 30 rows — one per day. Columns: day offset, channel, pillar, format (reel/carousel/story/text), content topic, hook draft, CTA, and production effort (high/med/low). Respect the pillar ratios and channel rhythm, and leave at least one slot per week flagged as a trend-reactive slot (topic decided on the day).
nodes.acceptance: All 30 rows filled; pillar mix within ±10 percentage points of the design.

subtasks.title: Lay out 30 slots
subtasks.purpose: Dates and channels following the rhythm

subtasks.title: Fill topics, hooks, CTAs
subtasks.purpose: Each row concrete enough to brief a creator

subtasks.title: Check the pillar mix
subtasks.purpose: Verify actual ratios match the design

nodes.title: Verify calendar completeness
nodes.detail: Check that row_count is 30, no row has an empty hook or CTA, pillar_distribution stays within ±10 percentage points of the designed ratios, and no hook line repeats verbatim.
